notes.title: THE LAST BLADE 2 NETCODE OVERHAUL
notes.content:
That's right! This new major update to THE LAST BLADE 2 features the following:
[list]

[*]Code Mystics' unique Rollback netcode (previously featured in SSVS/KOF97/GAROU)
[*]Added Stretch option in Border Art mode (stretch game screen to 16:9)
[*]Added full-screen windowed mode support
[*]Now reports the number of full sessions when there are no sessions available to join in Find a Match
[*]New Character Wins Leaderboard submenu
[*]Now use standard navigation buttons in the menus when using a Xbox-style controller (A = accept, B = cancel, rather than using game action button mappings)
[*]Added "Top" and "Me" options to Leaderboard views
[*]Improve option to map digital and/or analogue game controls separately
[*]Make a sound when someone joins your room
[*]Changed cropping of playfield
[/list]

Check out this video for an in-depth look at how Code Mystics' rollback works:
[previewyoutube=1JHetORRpfQ;full][/previewyoutube]

So come on! Pick up your sword and let's fight our way to Hell's Gate!
